myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Sarnath appears in buddhist tradition as first sermon, deer park. The name's meaning, "Lord of the deer", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Sarnath in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Sarnath remains a touchstone for understanding buddhist religion, art, and identity.
